_source: vmangos world DB table creature_classlevelstats (unit_class 1 warrior / 2 paladin / 8 mage). Applied by Creature::SelectLevel: max_health = round(health * creature_template.health_multiplier); melee damage min/max = melee_damage_avg * damage_multiplier * (1 -/+ damage_variance); armor = armor * armor_multiplier. melee_damage_avg is per swing at the template base_attack_time (2000 ms for almost all normal mobs).
